scope: 根据仓库逐seed、逐cell聚合表独立复算；没有从全部逐样本预测重新计算AUC；没有新训练。

metric_semantics.difference: SB minus SN; AUC higher is better, LogLoss lower is better
metric_semantics.macro: equal average over six domain-task cells
metric_semantics.weighted_auc: weighted sum of within-cell AUC, not pooled AUC
metric_semantics.AULC: arithmetic average of per-epoch metric over stated interval, not endpoint
metric_semantics.own_final: each run actual final budget; not necessarily a common epoch
metric_semantics.uncertainty: training seeds are repetitions; draws/cells/epochs/bootstrap are not extra training seeds
